invalidState.title: The contract has changed
invalidState.body: Someone acted on this contract in the meantime. Reload to see where it stands.

offerExpired.title: The offer passed its start date
offerExpired.body: An offer can be accepted until the contract starts. Ask {juristic} to offer it again.

overlap.title: Another management contract covers these dates
overlap.body: {building} has one manager at a time; another offered or active contract overlaps this term.

resolutionRequired.title: A resolution appointing the manager is needed
resolutionRequired.body: Attach the adopted resolution of {building} that appoints the company, then offer the contract.

resolutionInvalid.title: The resolution cannot be used
resolutionInvalid.body: It must belong to {building} and be adopted.

pmTenantInvalid.title: This PM company was not found
pmTenantInvalid.body: Check the company code the PM company gave you.

vendorBlocked.title: The vendor is blocked
vendorBlocked.body: The PM company is blocked in the vendor register. Unblock it before offering.

accept.title: Accept the management contract for {building}
accept.body: Once accepted, the company sees the building's aggregate figures from {juristic} from {from} to {to}, read-only — never residents, invoices or ledger lines.

decline.title: Decline the offer for {building}
decline.body: The reason is shown to {juristic}; they may offer again.

cancel.title: Cancel the management contract for {building}
cancel.body: {pm} will no longer see this offer. An accepted contract is terminated instead.

offer.title: Offer the contract to {pm}
offer.body: The PM company sees the offer and may accept it until the start date, {date}.

terminate.title: Terminate the management contract for {building}
terminate.bodyPm: From the effective date the company no longer sees this building, fees stop at the last day of service and staff assignments end. The {fees, plural, one {# fee} other {# fees}} already requested stay.
terminate.bodyJuristic: From the effective date the PM company no longer sees the building and fees stop at the last day of service. The {fees, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} already made stay for approval as usual.
terminate.effectiveOnError: Choose a date in the allowed range

assign.title: Assign staff to a building
assign.body: Choose the building, the person and the role. The assignment must fall within that building's management contract.

error.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start
error.notMember: This person is not an active member of the company
error.outsideTerm: Must fall within the contract, {from} to {to}
error.overlap: This person is already assigned here on overlapping days

assign.startsOnHint: Empty = today, or the contract start
assign.endsOnHint: The first day off this building; empty = until the contract ends

end.title: End {name}'s assignment at {building}
end.body: The date chosen is the first day no longer assigned.
end.ended: This assignment has already ended. Reload the page.

fact.dueValue: Day {day} of the month after each period

panel.expired: Past the start date ({date}) — it can no longer be accepted

body.offeredExpired: This offer can no longer be accepted; the juristic office must offer it again.
body.offeredPm: Can be accepted until the start date, {date}.
body.draft: This draft has not reached the PM company. It needs an adopted resolution appointing the manager before it can be offered.
body.activePm: Running. Fees are requested automatically at the end of each period; the juristic office approves and pays through its own steps.
body.activeJuristic: Running. At the end of each period an expense request for the fee is created for approval by band — nothing is paid automatically.
body.declined: The PM company declined this offer.
body.cancelled: The juristic office cancelled this offer.

panel.readOnly: You can read the contract; the owner or a manager accepts or terminates it.

access.title: Access to the building
access.bodyPm: The company sees the building's aggregate figures only (collection, arrears, budget, work), read-only.
access.bodyJuristic: The PM company sees the building's aggregate figures only, read-only — never residents, invoices or ledger lines.

charges.title: Fees requested
charges.ledePm: Requested at the end of each period; the juristic office approves and pays through its own steps.
charges.ledeJuristic: Each ended period is one expense request, approved by band and paid like any other expense.
charges.emptyBody: Fees are requested in arrears at the end of each period.

staff.title: PM company staff
staff.empty: No staff assigned to this building yet
staff.emptyBody: The PM company assigns its staff.

kpi.noBudgetLong: This building has no approved budget for this year.
kpi.requests: {count, plural, one {# open request} other {# open requests}}
kpi.workOrders: {count, plural, one {# work order} other {# work orders}}
kpi.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
kpi.vendorExpiring: {count, plural, one {# vendor contract} other {# vendor contracts}} ending
kpi.accounts: {count, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}} overdue

portfolio.title: Managed buildings
portfolio.lede: Figures as of {date} from each juristic office's books
portfolio.ledeNoDate: The buildings the company manages today
portfolio.offers: {count, plural, one {# contract offer} other {# contract offers}} waiting for an answer
portfolio.offersBody: Each can be accepted until its start date.

empty.title: No buildings under management today
empty.body: Buildings appear here once a management contract is running and the juristic office's access is in force. See the offers waiting.
empty.bodyStaff: Buildings appear here once you are assigned to one.

privacy: Aggregates only — no residents, invoices or ledger lines of the juristic office.

building.within: Collected within {days} days of the due date
building.noStaff: No staff assigned to this building yet
building.noStaffBody: Assign a building manager or staff from the side panel.

staff.title: Building staff
staff.emptyBody: Once a management contract is running, its building appears here for staffing.
staff.unassignedLede: Active members with no building today

contracts.title: Management contracts
contracts.lede: Offers from juristic offices and the contracts the company holds

pm.title: No contracts in this view
pm.body: No {tab} contracts yet. Offers from juristic offices arrive here.

juristic.title: No management contracts in this view
juristic.body: No {tab} contracts yet. The office's contracts with property management companies appear here.

juristic.title: Management contracts
juristic.lede: Contracts with property management companies for every building; each period's fee is an expense request for approval
